s.en: The guards kept watching the wreck and you never made your stance known, so they came on their own.

s.zh: \n\n让他们待满一小时，残骸就会被搬走；打退他们，残骸就还是你的。
s.en: \n\nLet them stay a full hour and the wreck will be hauled away; repel them and the wreck stays yours.

red-robed skeletons, and wild magic spills out within radius

s.zh: 格内野魔法四溢：附近的人和动物会时不时隐形、加速、被传送、头上开花、打嗝或者变色（都不致命）。\n\n
s.en: cells: nearby people and animals will now and then turn invisible, speed up, get teleported, sprout flowers on their heads, hiccup or change color (none of it fatal).\n\n

s.en: Dismantle it yourself: after defeating the guards, dismantle the wreck for scrolls, steel, plasteel and possibly wondrous items.\nWait for Thay to recover it: in 5 days Thay sends a recovery team to haul it away (they'll fight you; repel them and the wreck stays yours).\nNotify the alliance: needs a powered comms console and alliance goodwill ≥
